title: Tests.
officialText: Drain, waste and vent piping for water recycling systems shall be tested in accordance with Section PC312. Distribution piping for water recycling systems shall be tested in accordance with Section 312.5 of this code. Additional tests shall be performed in accordance with Sections C102.8.1 through C102.8.3.
